cookies.title: Use of cookies
cookies.bodyHtml: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience, understand your interest in our products and personalize our communications. By using our services, you acknowledge this functionality. More information can be found in our Privacy Policy.

phrases.Na década de 1960 o empresário Francisco: In the 1960s, entrepreneur Francisco Aragão Fontenelle saw an opportunity to invest in the apparel sector and created Confecções Royale S/A. The new company's production line focused on intimate apparel for the national market, a sector in which Ceará was beginning to stand out. This experience made clear the need for qualified suppliers capable of offering special fabrics and elastics.
phrases.A STIK inicia suas atividades em 1968 na: STIK began its activities in 1968 in Fortaleza, Ceará. Passamanaria do Nordeste S/A, through the Fontenele family, is a company from Ceará created to solve a gap in the intimate fashion segment, helping grow the local market with quality raw materials, fair prices and differentiated service.
phrases.Com espírito empreendedor, a STIK nasce: With an entrepreneurial spirit, STIK was born from the desire to provide agile, aligned solutions with customized service, believing in creative potential and, above all, ensuring quality in everything it does.
phrases.A Passamanaria do Nordeste S.A continua: Passamanaria do Nordeste S.A. continues to write its story in collaboration with all our internal and external customers, always believing in continuous partnership and understanding that we must INNOVATE to MOVE FORWARD.
phrases.Estamos prontos para atender você com ag: We are ready to help you quickly and clearly, with the support you need to answer questions, follow up on orders or start a new conversation with STIK.
phrases.Escolha o canal mais conveniente e fale: Choose the most convenient channel and speak with our team during business hours.
phrases.Preencha o formulário e retornaremos o m: Fill out the form and we will get back to you as soon as possible with the guidance you need.
phrases.Reunimos aqui as respostas para as dúvid: Here you will find answers to the most common questions about orders, delivery, payment and service.
phrases.1. Qual é o tempo de entrega dos produto: 1. What is the delivery time for products?
phrases.O tempo de entrega varia de acordo com a: Delivery time varies according to your location and product availability. You can check the exact deadline at checkout after entering your postal code.
phrases.2. Como posso rastrear meu pedido?: 2. How can I track my order?
phrases.Assim que seu pedido for enviado, você r: As soon as your order is shipped, you will receive an email with the tracking code and a link to follow the delivery directly with the carrier.
phrases.3. Posso trocar ou devolver um produto?: 3. Can I exchange or return a product?
phrases.Sim. A política de troca e devolução per: Yes. The exchange and return policy allows you to exchange or return products within 7 days of receipt. For more details, please see our Exchange and Return Policy.
phrases.Aceitamos Pix, boleto bancário e os prin: We accept Pix, bank slip and major credit cards. All transactions are secure and your data is protected.
phrases.5. Vocês têm loja física?: 5. Do you have a physical store?
phrases.Não. Atualmente, vendemos exclusivamente: No. We currently sell exclusively online through our official website, offering the convenience of buying from anywhere.
phrases.Quer desenvolver com este produto?: Want to develop with this product?
phrases.Fale com a nossa equipe para alinhar apl: Talk to our team to align application, volume and the ideal finish.
phrases.Confira as últimas notícias sobre a Stik: Check out the latest news about Stik and the fashion universe, with trends, launches, tips and more.
phrases.Esta Política de Privacidade explica com: This Privacy Policy explains how STIK collects, uses, stores and protects personal data while browsing the site, filling out forms and using communication features.
phrases.Tratamos dados pessoais para atendimento: We process personal data for service, sending news, improving the site and identifying interest in products, always according to the stated purpose and the preferences selected in the data banner.
We process personal data for service, sending news, improving the site and identifying interest in products, always according to the purpose stated in the data banner.
phrases.Dados opcionais de análise e marketing d: Optional analytics and marketing data depend on your choice.
phrases.Dados de análise, marketing e cidade/est: Analytics, marketing and city/state data depend on continuing after the banner notice and, for location, on browser permission.
phrases.Você pode rever suas preferências a qual: You can review your preferences at any time.
phrases.Não buscamos coletar dados sensíveis pel: We do not seek to collect sensitive data through the site.
phrases.A STIK é responsável pelo tratamento dos: STIK is responsible for processing the personal data collected on this site for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy.
phrases.Podemos coletar dados que você informa d: We may collect data you provide directly and limited interaction data, according to your choice in the banner.
We may collect data you provide directly and limited interaction data, according to the notice shown in the banner.
phrases.Dados de contato armazenados no arquivo: Contact data stored in the temporary file: email, when provided by you in forms.
phrases.Dados de atendimento: nome e mensagem po: Service data: name and message may be processed to answer requests sent through the form, without being included in the temporary visitor insights panel.
phrases.Produtos de interesse: produtos acessado: Products of interest: products accessed on the site.
phrases.Dados de dispositivo: tipo de dispositiv: Device data: device type, browser, operating system, language and screen size.
phrases.Cidade/estado: somente quando você autor: City/state: only when you authorize the browser to share location for conversion into city/state.
phrases.As coordenadas de localização são usadas: Location coordinates are used only to obtain city/state and are not stored in the temporary file.
phrases.Tratamos dados pessoais para finalidades: We process personal data for specific purposes, observing the LGPD, including the principles of purpose, adequacy, necessity, transparency and security.
phrases.Responder contatos e solicitações enviad: Respond to contacts and requests sent through forms.
phrases.Enviar catálogos, novidades, promoções e: Send catalogs, news, promotions and personalized communications when there is consent.
phrases.Entender uso por tipo de dispositivo qua: Understand usage by device type when you allow analytics.
phrases.Identificar produtos de interesse para m: Identify products of interest to improve offers, service and communications when you allow personalization and marketing.
phrases.Entender regiões de interesse comercial: Understand regions of commercial interest by city/state when you allow location.
phrases.As bases legais podem incluir consentime: Legal bases may include consent, execution of measures requested by you, compliance with legal or regulatory obligations and legitimate interest, depending on the case.
phrases.O site usa dados necessários para funcio: The site uses data necessary for basic operation. Optional device data, products of interest, city/state and commercial communication are collected according to the choice made in the data-use banner.

The site uses data necessary for basic operation. By selecting Continue in the banner, the site may record limited device data, products of interest, city/state and commercial communication for the purposes described in this policy.
phrases.Você pode aceitar tudo, recusar dados op: You can accept all, reject optional data or adjust preferences by purpose. The decision is stored in the browser and can be reviewed on this page.
phrases.A decisão fica registrada no navegador e: The decision is stored in the browser and can be reviewed on this page. When reviewing preferences, the notice is shown again before new optional collection.
phrases.Nesta fase de validação, apenas cidade/e: At this validation stage, only city/state, products of interest, provided email and device may be temporarily stored in an internal test file, with access restricted to authorized staff. This storage will be reviewed before final production use.
phrases.Quando a solução final for definida, a S: When the final solution is defined, STIK should establish retention periods, access controls and deletion routines compatible with each data purpose.
phrases.Podemos usar fornecedores de tecnologia: We may use technology providers for hosting, email sending, spam protection, service and site measurement. These providers must process data according to instructions, applicable contracts and security measures.
phrases.Quando você autorizar localização, as co: When you authorize location, coordinates may be checked with a geocoding service only to return city/state.
phrases.Nos termos da LGPD, você pode solicitar: Under the LGPD, you may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, blocking, deletion, information about sharing, portability when applicable, revocation of consent and objection to processing carried out unlawfully.
phrases.Adotamos medidas técnicas e administrati: We adopt technical and administrative measures to reduce risks of unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration or improper disclosure. No digital environment is completely risk-free, so we review controls as the site evolves.
phrases.Para exercer direitos ou tirar dúvidas s: To exercise rights or ask questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us through the official service channels: sac@stik.com or (85) 3202-5400.
phrases.Ao acessar e utilizar o site da STIK, vo: By accessing and using the STIK website, you agree to the conditions described on this page. They exist to ensure safe, ethical browsing aligned with the rights of the brand and users.
phrases.Os termos definem os limites de uso do c: The terms define the limits of content use, general responsibilities and the correct way to use this digital environment.
phrases.O conteúdo da STIK é protegido e não pod: STIK content is protected and cannot be used without authorization.
phrases.O uso do site deve respeitar a lei e os: Use of the site must respect the law and third-party rights.
phrases.As informações disponíveis são oferecida: The available information is provided as presented on the site.
phrases.Todo o conteúdo do site, incluindo texto: All site content, including texts, images, logos, visual elements and institutional materials, is the exclusive property of STIK and protected by applicable law. Use, reproduction or distribution without authorization is prohibited.
phrases.Você concorda em utilizar o site apenas: You agree to use the site only for lawful purposes, without infringing third-party rights, compromising the integrity of the digital environment or using content and data for improper or commercial purposes without prior authorization.
phrases.A STIK não se responsabiliza por danos d: STIK is not liable for direct, indirect or consequential damages arising from use of the site or product purchases, subject to the situations provided by law. The information provided is presented as is and may be updated without prior notice.
phrases.Ao continuar navegando, você confirma qu: By continuing to browse, you confirm that you understand these conditions and agree to use STIK content and services responsibly and in a manner compatible with this environment.
